allowed: Candidate 2 shares a strong related pharmacophore with a published potent hA2A antagonist SAR series.
Candidates 4 and 5 occupy an established pyrimidine-5-carbonitrile adenosine-receptor chemotype space.
虎杖-derived resveratrol has direct A2A agonist evidence and separate preclinical NASH evidence.
Istradefylline is a clinically used A2A antagonist anchor, not a MASH or candidate-identity claim.
Any of the five could remain a prospective new-lead branch if direct activity is confirmed and novelty is independently qualified.
forbidden: Any Mcule candidate is derived from 虎杖, 姜黄, tea, coffee, or another herb.
A related scaffold proves the candidate is an A2A antagonist.
Natural-product A2A activity proves MASH efficacy.
A computational hit is an innovative drug.
The reverse-mapping layer releases W0 or wet-lab gates.

decision.clinical_drug_anchor: istradefylline -> FDA-approved A2A antagonist for Parkinson disease; no MASH indication
decision.overall: The five are better interpreted as synthetic computational hits positioned relative to known ADORA2A medicinal chemistry. Reverse mapping yields concrete pharmacology and TCM/natural-product anchors, but no candidate-specific herb origin or approved-drug identity.
decision.qualified_concrete_tcm_anchor: 虎杖 -> resveratrol -> direct A2A agonist evidence; NASH evidence is preclinical and mixed
decision.secondary_natural_anchor: Curcuma longa/curcumin -> A2A activation evidence plus separate steatohepatitis antifibrotic evidence; causal A2A-liver link unproven
